topic: Convexity Action Engine: an ordinal, judgement-labelled atlas of everyday actions

actions.name: Learn to cook a new dish

ruin.trig: swimming alone, open water, alcohol, exhaustion, lightning

ruin.p: very low; higher in midday heat

ruin.trig: riding on roads, darkness, no helmet

actions.name: Go for a swim in the sea

ruin.p: low; unknown for a given spot
unknown; materially higher than a supervised pool
ruin.trig: no one to raise the alarm, currents

avoid.why: Same goal as swimming, but with no one to help if something goes wrong.
Two ordinary actions whose combination creates a catastrophic tail.
Small per-trip probability, repeated across trips, with irreversible and legal consequences.
The message rarely matters; the tail is permanent.

ruin.p: low per trip; higher when sleep-deprived

avoid.why: Fatigue is invisible to the driver until the micro-sleep.

actions.name: Cycle on roads at night without lights

ruin.p: unknown; higher than daytime with lights

avoid.why: Same exercise benefit is available with lights or on a park connector.

actions.name: Run hard in the midday heat

ruin.p: low; higher in tropical midday heat

avoid.why: In Singapore the same run in the early morning or evening keeps the benefit and drops most of the heat tail.

ruin.trig: a fall with no one knowing where you are

avoid.why: Telling someone your route costs a minute and caps the tail.

actions.name: Swim in the sea during a thunderstorm

ruin.trig: storms, which in Singapore are often afternoon

avoid.why: Outdoor water during lightning combines two catastrophic tails.
The warm-up is cheap; the injury can cost months.
Stopping keeps nearly all of the long-run benefit.
Waiting changes nothing if it is benign and can be irreversible if it is not.
Taking it is a two-minute action with a large protected downside.
Check the label or ask a pharmacist first.

actions.name: Leave the stove on and go out

avoid.why: A two-second check removes a catastrophic tail.

ruin.trig: writing while angry; cannot be unsent

avoid.why: Drafting now and sending tomorrow keeps every option.
The upside is small and brief; the record is permanent.

actions.name: Invest borrowed money in a speculative asset

ruin.trig: leverage turns a drawdown into a debt

avoid.why: Unlevered, diversified saving keeps most upside without the ruin path.
Negative expected value, repeated, with an absorbing bottom.

actions.name: Take on high-interest debt for a purchase

ruin.p: moderate if the balance rolls over

avoid.why: Waiting or buying second-hand keeps the item within reach without the tail.

actions.name: Sign a contract without reading it

avoid.why: Reading the key clauses is cheap relative to the lock-in.

ruin.trig: urgent messages asking you to log in or pay

avoid.why: Going to the site directly costs seconds.
Searching while employed keeps the same upside with a floor.

actions.name: Make a major decision while exhausted or angry

avoid.why: Sleeping on it is reversible; many major decisions are not.
Not dangerous, just poor payoff: little upside and it taxes tomorrow.

actions.name: Stay up all night before a big day

avoid.why: Poor payoff rather than ruin: sleep usually beats the extra hours.
